name: Cefixime
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: Reduced daily suspension volume (see kidney table)

key_interactions.effect: Prolonged prothrombin time / higher INR reported (label).

contraindications: Known allergy to cefixime or other cephalosporins

pk.half_life: 3 to 4 hours (up to 9 hours in some healthy people)
pk.half_life_eskd: About 6.4 hours at CrCl 20–40; 11.5 hours at CrCl 5–20 (label)
pk.excretion_renal_pct: About 50% of the absorbed dose unchanged in urine in 24 hours; over 10% in bile (animal data)

sources.citation: Lupin Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (2025). Cefixime capsules and cefixime for oral suspension [Prescribing information; US FDA-approved label, ANDA065129, set ID 6d68dbd9-7d75-4ff1-91db-79ff8ae879ec, version effective October 14, 2025]. DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine.
